certificate_rules.PROVED: named input-unit plus named input-implication path ending at C
certificate_rules.REFUTED: named input-unit plus named input-implication path ending at not-C
certificate_rules.INDEPENDENT: two complete models of T, one satisfying C and one satisfying not-C
certificate_rules.UNKNOWN: no logical claim; timeout, resource exhaustion, or voluntary abstention

training_tracks.trained: identical lower-horizon sibling examples and independently verified certificates supplied to every learning system; test seeds remain held out
